values.note: $20 a night per site, paid at check-in for the whole stay (host or drop box); no refunds. Dump station $20, registered campers only.

fees.source: https://hinsdalecounty.colorado.gov/recreation-campground-boatdock ('Rates: $20.00 per night. RV Dump Located At Campground, Dump Fee: $20.') + Wupperman Rules 2026.pdf ('depositing the registration form and $20 per day, per site fee with the campground host ... Camper must pay for entire stay at time of check-in'), read 2026-10-28

hookups.source: https://hinsdalecounty.colorado.gov/recreation-campground-boatdock ('No electricity.'; water from spigots at the toilets per the county map) + Wupperman Rules 2026.pdf ('Faucet adaptors and hoses must be disconnected after use'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: 31 sites of various lengths for RVs, tents and ADA campers, on the lakeshore or on the cliffs above; a few tent-only sites; the north loop (26-31) has no water. No maximum length published.

sites.source: https://hinsdalecounty.colorado.gov/recreation-campground-boatdock ('31 sites with excellent views of the lake. Various site lengths will accommodate ADA campsites, RVs and/or tents. Sites are available on the lake or on the cliffs above.') + Wupperman map new.pdf (tent sites 12-15, ADA sites 7-8, 'NO WATER' at sites 26-31), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Water spigots at the toilets; RV tanks may be filled. Bear lockers.

facilities.source: https://hinsdalecounty.colorado.gov/recreation-campground-boatdock ('Water, trash removal, vault toilets, picnic tables, grills and fire gates'; 'RV Dump Located At Campground') + Wupperman Rules 2026.pdf ('Campers and Visitors are welcome to fill water jugs and RV water tanks'; 'Campers should use provided bear lockers'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Opens Memorial Day weekend, closes the last week of September.

season.source: https://hinsdalecounty.colorado.gov/recreation-campground-boatdock ('Wupperman closes the last week of September and opens for the summer on Memorial Day Weekend.'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: First-come, first-served; no reservations. 14-night limit per site.

booking.source: https://hinsdalecounty.colorado.gov/recreation-campground-boatdock ('We do not accept reservations. Camping spots are available on a first-come, first-serve basis.') + Wupperman Rules 2026.pdf ('No reservations, no deposits'; 'limited to fourteen (14) days'), read 2026-10-28

note: Hinsdale County campground on the east shore of Lake San Cristobal south of Lake City, at about 9,000 ft on gravel County Road 33. The county's map marks a steep, narrow stretch of CR33 at the overlook between the main sites and the north loop. Sites on the lakeshore and on the cliffs above; public fishing access. --Claude
summary: Hinsdale County page + 2026 rules + map: confirmed $20 (2026), 31 sites, no hookups, vault toilets, water, dump ($20), FCFS only; added season Memorial Day weekend to last week of September, 14-night limit, payment rules; note trimmed of fee/amenity restatements and the unsourced length and CR30 claims.
flags: Waterfront re-audit lead (stored lakeview): the county says 'Sites are available on the lake or on the cliffs above.' On imagery the 21-22 loop sits on a bench at the shoreline point, and the north loop (26-31) is along CR33 at the water's edge with vehicles parked by the lake; other sites (16 and the cliff loops) are high above it. Some sites look lakefront; a re-audit should decide whether the entry earns lakefront.

CR33 access: the county pages do NOT advise against RVs. The county's campground map labels the CR33 stretch at the overlook (between sites 22-25 and the north loop) 'STEEP AND NARROW'. The stored note's 'narrow with some steep dropoffs; CR30 a paved/wider alternative' had no source I could find; dropped from the note.

Length: no maximum published by the county ('Various site lengths will accommodate ... RVs'). The stored note's '~25 ft max, lower lakeshore sites take bigger rigs' came from directory reports (Campendium: 'Small RV's only', longest reported 30 ft); dropped. EKKO at 23 ft should fit the RV sites, but there is no agency figure.
Rate conflict: lakecity.com (tourism) lists '$15'; the county page and the 2026 rules say $20. Used $20.
Season dates: the county gives 'Memorial Day Weekend' to 'the last week of September'; recorded 05-23 to 09-30 (2026 Memorial Day weekend began May 23).
Phone 970-944-2225 (County Administration Office) matches. Website is the county page. Ownership local correct.
